research_question: How much information about an impending support-slip transition is available from safe tool-side interaction before significant slip occurs?

experiments.name: basic_pretransition_identifiability
experiments.purpose: Test whether a fixed safe tool-side probe contains enough information to predict which threshold will be reached first.

experiments.name: information_vs_safety_force_sweep
experiments.purpose: Test whether stronger probing reveals more pre-transition information before increasing threshold-crossing risk.

experiments.name: rigid_vs_compliant_support
experiments.purpose: Test whether measurable pre-slip support motion creates useful pre-transition information.

experiments.name: sensor_ablation
experiments.purpose: Identify which tool-side observation channels carry predictive information.

experiments.name: minimum_sensing_requirement
experiments.purpose: Estimate how precursor strength and motion-sensor noise jointly affect pre-transition separability.

experiments.name: sensing_heatmap
experiments.purpose: Visualize pre-transition identifiability across precursor-strength and sensor-noise conditions.

experiments.name: precursor_to_noise_scaling
experiments.purpose: Test whether identifiability approximately follows a precursor-to-noise ratio.

experiments.name: phase0_results_recording
experiments.purpose: Create a machine-readable record of key Phase 0 sweep results.

experiments.name: seed_robustness
experiments.purpose: Test whether separability and transition-rate conclusions are stable across random seeds.

experiments.name: parameter_sensitivity
experiments.purpose: Test whether conclusions depend strongly on the sampled physical parameter ranges.

kill_criteria.name: no_useful_preslip_information
kill_criteria.rule: If no legal tool-side interaction produces meaningful pre-transition separability before significant slip occurs, report the limitation and stop rather than silently adding direct container-pose sensing.

kill_criteria.name: no_safety_benefit
kill_criteria.rule: If later active diagnosis improves inference but does not reduce unsafe force escalation relative to a push-harder baseline, the original safety motivation is not supported.

kill_criteria.name: excessive_diagnostic_cost
kill_criteria.rule: If useful inference requires too many diagnostic actions or too much time to fit within the intended safety budget, the method is not useful under the intended setting.

notes: Generated results are properties of the toy model, not claims about real robotic hardware.
Container pose is intentionally hidden in the default Phase 0 condition.
Mismatch detection itself is not claimed as novel.
Synthetic Gut and internal embodiment are out of scope for this repository.
